product: imported branded fashion (Michael Kors, Guess, Calvin Klein)
timeline: Opened a physical shop in early 2016; in September (2017) announced the shop would continue online only
what_worked: Most sales already came through Facebook and Instagram pages
Going online-only cut the high rent; orders now come from all over Albania and sometimes abroad instead of only her neighbourhood
what_failed: Physical shop did not pay for its rent; closed

business: Shopping TV / jumbo.al / top fashion / mjeshtri.im
product: general consumer products sold through TV-shopping and online portals
timeline: Started as a TV-shopping channel; moved to online portals when TV declined; 90% of orders from portals by 2018
what_worked: Cut TV costs to a minimum once 90% of orders came from online portals
Switched from Albanian suppliers to contracts with foreign suppliers, buying most products from the first supplier, which let it sell at lower prices
what_failed: Started with local (Albanian) suppliers: many difficulties, high costs, lower profits
Customer-acquisition cost rising: Facebook and Instagram bring fewer followers and customers for the same money
Saturated market: most operators sell at prices close to cost; some operators leave the market every year; older firms stagnated as new ones entered
numbers: 90% of orders from online portals, 10% from TV
Market players say about 30% of online clothing orders are returned by buyers

product: marketplace listing local retail shops' products
timeline: One year in by 2018: 130 retail shops and over 30,000 products listed
what_worked: Offering cash on delivery: 'If I had not introduced cash payments, today I would be out of the market'
Shops keep their own name on the platform
what_failed: Entering the market was harder than expected
Shops do not manage their own product pages (choice, photos, pricing), which limits growth
numbers: Over 90% of Albanian online sales paid cash on delivery (market players)
note: Buyers distrust prepayment because informal sellers took payment and did not deliver or delivered the wrong goods (founder's view)
